title: Realization and account closure
description: Whether an identical outcome is represented as still provisional or as finalized in its accounting status, while amount, ownership, timing, and availability remain constant.

contrast_conditions.label: Provisional and unresolved
contrast_conditions.definition: The scenario represents the focal outcome as not yet finalized while holding its objective amount and availability fixed.

contrast_conditions.label: Finalized and settled
contrast_conditions.definition: The scenario represents the same focal outcome as finalized while holding its objective amount and availability fixed.

probe_prompt_template:
Read the following short third-person scenario. Preserve the situation in working memory without answering the downstream task.

Scenario:
{scenario}

Continue processing the scenario.

independent_behavior_task.prompt_template: For a separate choice, Option A is a risky option with a stated probability and Option B is a sure option. Allocate 0 to 100 points to Option A; the remaining points go to Option B. Use only the stated payoff frame, amounts, and probability in this item. Return exactly one integer from 0 to 100: the points assigned to Option A, the risky option.
independence_requirements: Use new domains, entities, and payoff amounts not present in probe prompts.
Cross gain and loss items with stake level, probability, and narrative option order; reserve neutral items for calibration.
Option A must always mean the risky option even when the prose narrates the sure option first.
Do not ask the model to classify realization, closure, or any probe condition.

behavior.warning: This is an account-closure state direction, not a generic risk-policy parameter.

parsing_rules.response_contract: exactly one integer from 0 through 100 representing points assigned to Option A, the risky option

metadata.primary_question: Does a train-only account-closure direction transfer to risky allocation in a new task?
